title: docs(spec): server.trustProxy describe says "two consumers" but the per-endpoint rate limiter is a third
body:
Filing gate **① a measured defect** (a documentation inaccuracy), found by the retroactive contract review of PR #24859 (record `6308841043`, merge `55d7aaba4c`, closes #24818). Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 3 (session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## The finding

The `server.trustProxy` `.describe()` text in `packages/spec/src/system/stack-server.zod.ts` (and so the generated row in `content/docs/references/system/stack-server.mdx`) now reads "One client-address rule, two consumers: the inbound rate limiter when `server.security.rateLimit.enabled` is set, and the authentication plugin …".

On `origin/main` there is a third caller of the same rule:
- `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-policy.ts:366-372` calls `resolveRateLimitKey({… trustProxy: input.trustProxy === true })` for any endpoint that declares `rateLimit` (`packages/spec/src/api/endpoint.zod.ts:189`).
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts:2278-2282` passes `config.rateLimit?.trustProxy` into that chain. The registry is built unconditionally (`dispatcher-plugin.ts:2115`), so it does not depend on `server.security.rateLimit.enabled`.

The same file's own header (`stack-server.zod.ts:56`) already names "the endpoint policy chain". No key, default or behaviour is misstated. Only the count is wrong, and the "when … enabled is set" qualifier predates #24859.

## Candidate shape (for triage)

Name the endpoint-policy chain as a consumer, or drop the count, and regenerate the reference with `gen:schema && gen:docs`. `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`.

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue updated since 2026-09-01 (any state), from the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, matched on `trustProxy` in the title or body.
- Parent, closed: #24818.
- Related, closed: #24739 and #24799 (both about the client-address rule).
- Related, open: #24740 (`HARDENING.md` and `production-readiness.mdx` on rate limiting). Those are other files, and this card does not overlap it.
- **New.**
